limits: PostToolUse fires after the tool has already run. A blocked result keeps the model from reading it. It does not undo a shell command or a file write. That is what PreToolUse is for.
MessageDisplay changes the text on screen only. The transcript, and what Claude sees on the next turn, keep the original reply. Exit code 2 does not block this event.
A PostToolUse or MessageDisplay process that dies before printing JSON fails open. The CLI still catches judge errors and prints a refusal so a Jev failure is not a silent allow.
